searches.title: Formally adopted AI-focused instrument of Turkmenistan
searches.queries: English: "Turkmenistan artificial intelligence concept resolution President 2025 official"
searches.source_universe: General web search results, including official Turkmen government websites and international organisations' pages that the search returned.
searches.inclusion_criteria: A public instrument of Turkmenistan, formally adopted, that focuses primarily on artificial intelligence (RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md §3.1, working model).
searches.exclusion_criteria: Drafts, strategies in preparation, announcements, and broader digital-economy instruments without an identified AI focus.
searches.sources_examined:
oilgas.gov.tm, news item of 2 February 2026: reports a presidential resolution approving the State Program for the Development of the Digital Economy for 2026–2028. A broader digital-economy instrument; recorded in the contextual registry; its text was not examined.
undp.org, press release on support to Turkmenistan's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: reports a validation workshop in May 2026 for a strategy still being finalised. Not adopted; excluded.
searches.method: One web search in English on 2026-10-30 and the reading of two of its results on 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-02, performed by Claude Code under the project owner's delegation (ADR-0020 point 10). Turkmen- and Russian-language sources and the official legal gazette were not searched.
searches.summary: No formally adopted AI-focused instrument of Turkmenistan was found in the sources examined. One source reports that a national AI strategy is being prepared; preparation is not adoption. This finding is bounded by one English-language web search and two pages read, and is not evidence that no such instrument exists.

searches.title: Formally adopted AI-focused instrument of Uzbekistan
searches.queries: English: "Uzbekistan presidential resolution artificial intelligence strategy 2030 lex.uz"
searches.source_universe: General web search results, and the national database of legislation lex.uz.
searches.inclusion_criteria: A public instrument of Uzbekistan, formally adopted, that focuses primarily on artificial intelligence (RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md §3.1, working model).
searches.exclusion_criteria: Drafts, announcements, and news reports where the official record could be read instead.
searches.sources_examined:
lex.uz, record 7159258: Resolution of the President RP-358 of 14.10.2024 approving the Strategy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technologies until 2030; in force from 17.10.2024. Metadata read; no text kept.
gov.uz, Ministry of Digital Technologies news item announcing the decree. Secondary; the official record was used instead.
searches.method: One web search in English on 2026-10-30, and the reading of the lex.uz record's metadata on 2026-11-02, performed by Claude Code under the project owner's delegation (ADR-0020 point 10). Earlier or other AI-related acts were not searched for.
searches.summary: One formally adopted AI-focused instrument was found and registered by its metadata: resolution RP-358 of 14.10.2024. Its assignment to the core corpus is provisional. The search was not exhaustive: other AI-related acts of Uzbekistan may exist.
